map.收回初始投资所需的年数。: The number of years needed to recover the initial investment.

map.累计 −1000→−700→−300→+200，第 3 年回正，回收期 = 2+: Cumulative −1000→−700→−300→+200, turning positive in year 3; payback period = 2+300/500 = 2.6 years.
map.累计现金流依次为 −1000、−600、−200、+200、+400，在第 2→: Cumulative cash flows are −1000, −600, −200, +200, +400, turning positive between periods 2→3; the interpolated payback period =2+200/400=2.50 years, and the 200 CNY in period 5 does not affect the payback point.
map.回收期短就好？: Is a short payback period always good?
map.短回收期降风险但忽略回本后现金流；高回报长周期项目可能被误筛掉，需结合 NPV。: A short payback reduces risk but ignores cash flows after break-even; high-return long-cycle projects may be wrongly screened out, so combine it with NPV.
map.回收期为什么不能单独用于决策？: Why can the payback period not be used for decisions on its own?
map.它既忽略回收期之后的现金流，也不考虑资金的时间价值。一个 2.5 年回本但之后毫: It ignores both cash flows after the payback point and the time value of money. A project that pays back in 2.5 years but earns nothing afterwards may be worse than one that pays back in 4 years yet has rich long-term cash flows, so it must be used together with NPV and IRR.
